selection_rule: Among k with sampled silhouette within 0.03 of max, maximize mean seed ARI, then silhouette, then smaller k
transform: log1p on counts, then StandardScaler fitted to training cells only
limitation: Clusters describe mapped Overture POI category counts, not verified attraction quality, tourist demand, popularity, accessibility or an AHP Tourism Potential Index. Empty cells reflect selected-source mapping coverage and excluded categories. Service and attraction candidate records may contain duplicates or errors.
